notes.title: Tengami v1.0.4
notes.content:
Updated to latest version of WWise and fixed sound crackling issues.
Updated to latest version of SDL.
Improved frame rate consistency for high frequency monitors.

Known issue:
Switching between window mode and fullscreen during play can cause some issues on some cards. Please restart the game after making changes to be safe.



Please keep reporting any issues you encounter with the game, so we can keep on improving support. Many thanks.

notes.title: Tengami v1.0.3
notes.content:
Here is the list of changes. They should fix several reasons why the game isn't launching on some machines.

[list]
[*] Changes to Open GL 2.1 initialization for people getting Open GL related error messages.
[*] Changes to Steam API initialization, so no one should have to disable the 'Steam Overlay' feature in order to launch the game.
[/list]


Please keep reporting any issues you encounter with the game, so we can keep on stabilizing it. Thank you!

notes.title: Tengami v1.0.2
notes.content:
We just uploaded a new version of Tengami to Steam. 

Here is the list of changes:

[list][*] Version number is displayed in the 'Settings' so you know whether your game is up-to-date.
[*] Enhanced error reporting to help people who have issue launching the game locating the problem. This can be a variety of issues with graphics card drivers. Please report the errors in our forum for further assistance. It is our aim to eventually fix most of the issues from within the game. 
[*] Added support for Steam error reporting, so we can look at the issues in more detail.[/list]

notes.title: Bug Update - 17/01/2014
notes.content:
First of all massive thanks to the community for reporting issues with the game and helping us to troubleshoot them. Thanks to everyone's collaboration we were able to resolve some issues and make progress on others.

[b]Save Game - Resolved [/b]
There was an issue with the game not saving correctly through Steam Cloud for some people. We believe that of this morning the issue is fixed and the game should save correctly for everyone now. Please note that the game uses an auto save system. Once you back to the game's main menu there should be an option 'Continue Game' is you have saved progress.

[b] No mouse input - Resolved[/b]
If the game is unresponsive to mouse input then you probably don't have VSync enabled. This is a setting in your graphics card driver . You can enable this through the Graphics setting in the Control Center. We are looking into forcing VSync from within the game, so no one has to change this manually in the future. It might also be worth updating your graphics card driver.

[b]Game doesn't launch  - Work in progress[/b]
This is a bit of an odd issue, that a quick google search revealed is a mysterious issue for quite a few games.  The main problem here seems to be a missing / corrupt / inaccessible MSVCP110.dll This file is usually part of Windows and is used by many programs. As a first step we have included the 'VS Studio 2012 - Distribution' as part of the game install. From what I understand this should be done by Steam automatically and not require any kind of manual install. Even with a re-install of the DLL the game still does not launch for a small number of people. We keep investigating the reasons for this. 

[b]Sound dropping - Work in Progress[/b]
The music seems to be cutting out for some people. We are still looking into the reasons for this.
